needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install a proper, continuous sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the footway to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: uneven sections and trip hazards on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: pedestrians crossing in the absence of a crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with refuge islands to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: road has 4 or more lanes and no refuge for pedestrians at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.
